🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
ROTATION with Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Cycle constructive (Copper/Gold ↑; Consumer Cycle ABOVE TREND) while risk is mixed with HYG/LQD flagged as CREDIT STRESS ↓ and VXX (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -13.92%) RECOVERY.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +1.83%) and LQD (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +1.58%) imply the HYG/LQD signal is negative (CREDIT STRESS ↓). Fear is subdued on the month but choppy: VXX (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -13.92%) RECOVERY, while Stocks vs Bonds is ABOVE TREND (SPY/TLT level rising; SPY (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar modest recovery: UUP (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -0.29%) RECOVERY and duration preference is ABOVE TREND, while the yield curve remains relatively steep (Yield Curve ABOVE TREND), keeping financial conditions supportive for risk assets.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leadership confirmed: XLK (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +15.44%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +28.28%) ABOVE TREND are clear winners, while defensives lag (XLU (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +0.20%) CORRECTION), implying Growth/Momentum leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US still leading: SPY (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +8.52%) ABOVE TREND, but EM and China participation is visible—EEM (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +10.59%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +0.24% | 1M: +4.49%) ABOVE TREND—while Europe VGK (1W: -1.01% | 1M: +7.53%) is in CORRECTION.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation healthy: IWM (1W: +2.63% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +11.82%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on positioning and elevated appetite.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial reflation intact: CPER (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +12.14%) ABOVE TREND and base/industrial metals strength visible, while precious metals are in short-term profit-taking—GLD (1W: -1.18% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +12.65%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed-to-recovering: BNO (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.40% | 1M: -5.18%) RECOVERY, while natural gas UNG (1W: +3.50% | 1M: -6.65%) RECOVERY shows short-term bounce but negative monthly trend.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech and semis (XLK and SOXX) both 1W and 1M positive (ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: Financials XLF (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +8.38%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION create a cross-market rotation signal to monitor for momentum fade.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure and cyclicals given tech/semis strength and EM participation—XLK (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +15.44%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +28.28%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +10.59%) ABOVE TREND—reduce exposure to defensive utilities and watch credit-sensitive assets.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Continued semis outperformance (SOXX (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +28.28%) ABOVE TREND) → favor XLK and semis exposure; BEARISH: Utilities/Defensives (XLU (1W: -2.50% | 1M: +0.20%) CORRECTION) → reduce exposure to defensive buckets while monitoring signs of breadth deterioration.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER (1W: +0.91% | 1M: +12.14%) ABOVE TREND) and oil (BNO (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND); BEARISH: Gold and silver near-term pullback (GLD (1W: -1.18% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION, SLV (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +12.65%) CORRECTION) if risk sentiment flips.

13. Key Levels?  
VIX/VXX spot: VIX level 29.55 and VXX (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -13.92%) RECOVERY as a complacency/fear watch; Credit Spread 0.7330 (watch HYG/LQD signal); Tech vs Financials ratio 3.0280 and SPY/TLT 8.1993 are key regime pivots.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. XLK (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +15.44%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +28.28%) show leadership alongside small caps IWM (1W: +2.63% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and EM EEM (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +10.59%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is the credit signal (HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↓) and corrections in XLF (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +8.38%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION—monitor for widening divergence.
